item.title: Simulations show how first stars transformed the universe
item.description: Detailed simulations reveal how early stars illuminated the dark universe and dispersed elements like carbon, oxygen, and iron.

item.title: ESA's Juice uses Earth gravity assist to reach Jupiter
item.description: ESA's Juice spacecraft flew past Earth on September 28, leveraging its gravity to alter course toward Jupiter without fuel.

item.title: Protective enzyme may slow fatty liver disease progression
item.description: Researchers have identified an enzyme that appears to defend naturally against worsening fatty liver disease, a condition affecting an estimated 100 million people.

item.title: Chang'e-6 lunar soil holds unexpected magnetic record
item.description: Analysis of Chang'e-6 lunar soil has revealed a previously unknown magnetic mineral in natural Moon samples: a form of metallic iron.
